name: io.github.open-resume-agent/ora-mcp
title: Open Resume Agent
description: Serve an ORA resume agent file over MCP: filtered profile, role views, job-fit context, resume rendering (docx/pdf/html/md/json) and handoff.

packageArguments.description: Path to the ORA agent file (public build recommended)

environmentVariables.name: ORA_MAX_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Highest audience the server may disclose: public | recruiter | verified_employer | owner

environmentVariables.name: ORA_OUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for rendered resumes and handoff logs
